safety: preserve settings, credentials and data on rerun
scope all Docker operations to this installation
publish FastCGI only on loopback in external mode
no PostgreSQL or Redis host ports
restore/update require explicit project confirmation and validated backup
no host web-server or firewall modifications
backup: stopped-stack archive with SHA-256 manifest; configurable destination; same-architecture fresh restore supported
updates: official versioned images within installed version families; no major database migration
administration: interactive menu, per-service lifecycle, configurable backups, fresh-path restore, SQL import/export, mounted PHP/FPM configuration
